name: Magical Happy ~Mahou wa H no Tehodoki!~
original_name: マジカルハッピー～魔法はHのてほどき！～
source:
Main character is a teacher in a magic school preparing a winning team for the National Magic Championship. However, the three students selected for the competition are all problem children...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名魔法学校的老师，正在为全国魔法锦标赛准备获胜队。然而，入选比赛的三名学生却都是问题儿童……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
